description: Bring an imported project up to date with the repository at its current commit. Extracts the facts locally and sends only the facts, so VibeMap applies the structural changes since the last import (added, changed and removed tables, policies and routes). It then reports the changed file paths, so specs whose code changed are flagged: a passed criterion whose files changed, or changed code that no spec covers, becomes a proposal the project owner reviews on the Codebase tab. Pass changedFiles (for example from `git diff --name-only <last synced commit>..HEAD`) to include edits that did not change the structure.

changedFiles.description: Optional extra repo-relative paths changed since the last sync (max 2000)

diffExcerpt.description: Optional excerpt of the diff (max 20000 chars), shown beside the proposals

localPath.description: Absolute path to the repository (defaults to the directory the server runs in)

name: vibemap_resync
